purpose: Restore a discoverable machine-ID pairing flow that works without AMC account or self-hosted API, retaining P2P IPv6

implementation.defaultPairing: Public broker rendezvous using nine-digit stable ID and one-use 96-bit random pairing password; compact copy/paste code also supported
publicBrokerProviders: EMQX via MQTT TLS with WSS fallback
implementation.crypto: HMAC-authenticated hello before slot allocation; ephemeral X25519; signed RSA-SHA256 host transcript and remembered certificate pin; HKDF-SHA256; directional AES-256-GCM signaling; bounded authenticated ordered envelopes
implementation.passwordLifetime: 5 minutes maximum, consumed before attended approval
implementation.media: WebRTC P2P IPv6/IPv4; no MQTT desktop frame/input/clipboard relay
implementation.optionalBackend: AMC account/API/TURN retained under advanced settings
implementation.interop: AMC to AMC; original Electron SwiftDesk wire protocol/IDs are not reused
implementation.permissionPolicy: Every real session requires host approval; input only after genuine frame and both channels

coverage: ID/copy-code and viewer without capture permission
No plaintext pairing password, trust token, names or SDP at broker
Wrong, expired or consumed password cannot reach host approval
Remembered reconnect still needs host approval; revoke blocks reuse
No silent downgrade of forced TURN
Stopping/quit drains public subscriptions even when optional backend shutdown fails
An unauthenticated public ID probe cannot allocate slots or exhaust authenticated challenge quota
Pairing controls visible in initial viewport and reachable from login without backend configuration

build.windows: not compiled; no Windows host available

installer.signing: ad-hoc; not Developer ID or notarized

integrationFixes: Runtime registry keeps public rendezvous cleanup/authorization separate from the optional AMC backend
Old backend remember callback checks that it still owns the active connection
A bounded partial ICE description can be exchanged after 5 seconds when real candidates exist even if STUN is unreachable; no-candidate timeout remains 12 seconds
Close callback avoids awaiting its own transport close future
Pairing is available from login without bypassing login for AMC project/team features
Network mode updates notify both default and advanced controls
earlierObservedFailure: First automatic native run stopped at ICE gathering timeout while waiting on unreachable STUN; corrected by bounded candidate exchange before the final passing six media cycles
limitations: Both endpoints run on one Mac, although signaling uses real public brokers; no two-ISP/cross-network proof
Windows compile/hardware/tray/installer and Win/Mac two-way input not validated
No OS input injected; DPI/IME/clipboard hardware checks pending
No real TURN service, performance benchmark, 60-minute soak, sleep/lock recovery, signed upgrade or login-item validation
Public broker availability is external; networks that block P2P may require the optional private TURN path
DMG is ad-hoc signed, not Developer ID/notarized
